why_not_exercised: A push publishes the whole branch, which is an external, hard-to-reverse act the operator has not asked for. The probe answers the question the closure asks — is publication still blocked? — without answering a different one on the operator's behalf.
consequence: The commits of this work package are local. One explicit instruction publishes them; the probe above says it takes seconds.
